newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss launch six-month money market claims. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Swiss launch six-month money market claims. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT]

text.p: The Swiss federal government is issuing six-month money market claims to be paid for on September 12, the Swiss National Bank said.
The allocation follows the end of subscriptions on September 10.
The previous issue of six-month claims, paid for on June 13, raised 1,029.15 million francs and was priced at 98.865 percent to yield 2.271 percent annually. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 258 7340

handling.status: Corrects headline and first paragraph to ready maturity as six-months rather than three-months.
